solutions.title: Repeated adjacent simulation
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly scan adjacent pairs and resolve the first wave of collisions until no pair can collide.

timeComplexity.explanation: A chain of collisions can require repeated passes over the survivor list.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A working survivor list is rebuilt per pass.

solutions.title: Stack simulation
solutions.strategy: Keep stable left-side survivors in a stack and resolve each incoming negative asteroid against positive stack tops.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each asteroid is pushed once and popped at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The survivor stack can hold every asteroid.
